列出所有任务(id/描述/目标/状态/运行时长/父任务/LLM 配置)，编排 a: List all tasks (id/description/goal/status/runtime/parent task/LLM profile) for orchestration overview, identifying stalled tasks and their LLMs. Runtime in seconds: running=creation to now; terminal=creation to last activity. llm_profile names the task planner/worker profile; (active profile) follows the globally active profile.
列出可用的 LLM 配置(profile)：id、名称、模型、格式、是否为当前激: List available LLM profiles: id, name, model, format, and whether currently active. Use id as spawn_task's llm_profile_id to assign a child task its own LLM (for example a cheaper reconnaissance model or a stronger exploitation model). Does not include API Keys.

可选：只读继承的来源任务 id 列表(最多 %d 个)。子任务可只读引用这些任务: Optional source task id list for read-only inheritance (at most %d). The child can reference discovered assets/conclusions as a starting point; unlike the parent_ref link, this inherits content.

可选：任务级超时(秒)。到点后触发优雅收尾并进入 timeout 终态；留空或: Optional task timeout in seconds. At the deadline, settle gracefully and enter terminal timeout status; omitted or 0 = unlimited
可选：planner 心跳触发间隔(秒)。距上轮规划结束/任务开始满该值且期间无: Optional planner heartbeat interval in seconds. After this interval since the last planning round ended/task started with no intervening trigger, run a planning round (deadlock fallback and supervision of in-flight workers). Omitted or 0 = default 600 (10min);
可选：对于简单任务可开启，创建时直接下发一条种子意图(内容=描述+目标)让 wo: Optional for simple tasks: issue a seed intent at creation (description+goal) so a worker can start without waiting for the first planner round; default false (standard plan-then-execute flow).

需要【交互输入】的程序（msfconsole / ssh 交互登录 / mysq: Do not use Bash for programs requiring interactive input (msfconsole / interactive ssh login / mysql, psql, python and other REPLs / password or yes/no prompts / nc reverse shells): it has no stdin and will hang. Use shell_open for an interactive session and shell_close when finished. Continue using Bash for one-shot noninteractive commands.
